trigger.propositional_logic_rejection: The package row has answer=null. Its own answer scores 0 while an unrelated string can score above 0, so it has no fixed target for this study.
trigger.tower_of_hanoi_rejection: At fixed declared difficulty, 128 generated rows contain only 6 distinct questions at three or five disks and 12 at seven disks with four pegs. It cannot supply 32 distinct prompt groups.
trigger.four_jug_rejection: Exploratory 64-row checks at four jugs made the package's stored oracle fail its own verifier in 7 to 12 rows at the tested levels. Three-jug levels had no oracle failures and remain eligible.

frozen_procedural_panel.static_gate: Every cell must replay byte-identically, supply 32 distinct prompts, give every stored oracle reward 1, and give both an empty answer and the fixed unrelated string reward 0. The frozen audit passes all 15 cells.
frozen_procedural_panel.reward_scope: These are deterministic programmatic rewards, not all binary rewards. Algebra, logic, and path tasks can give partial credit. Report both mean reward and full-reward rate.

procedural_generation_pilot.first_cell: Qwen3-0.6B thinking, all five medium task levels, eight rows per family
procedural_generation_pilot.generation: Greedy, 2048 maximum new tokens, one response per prompt, raw response retained
procedural_generation_pilot.contract_gate: At least 95 percent of rows must contain the final-answer marker and terminate with EOS; at most 5 percent may hit the generation limit.
procedural_generation_pilot.interpretation: This pilot checks prompt, parser, length, and verifier behavior. It does not estimate GRPO reward spread and cannot choose a final difficulty by itself.

native_length_result.finding: At 512 tokens, one row was cut off mid-solution and scored wrong. At 2048, all eight rows ended with EOS; that row ended at 683 tokens and scored correct.
native_length_result.decision: Use 2048 as this model's candidate evaluation ceiling. Keep the 512 report as the failed contract and test other native families separately.
